items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Anderson, he used to work with us too. Andrew Anderson.

ctx.x: His name is Joe Johnson. So who did he work with? He used to work with us. You know, with kid hours. And him and I went to... He did a little bit in us. Very fast. He got hit, man. Yeah, we got... Anderson, he used to work with us too. Andrew Anderson. You know what he said? We kind of had a fight, you know? Yeah. He used to work with us too.
Does he know a fella named Johnson played clarinet?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Earl and Andrew Anderson's cousin you know.

ctx.x: WDSU I think. Could have been WSMB.

We got Earl you see Earl Foster. Earl and Andrew Anderson's cousin you know. Oh yeah. I certainly would like to hear a record of Buddy Petit. Me too. Buddy must have made a record of somebody. You know what I'm saying sir? Cause him and Louis Armstrong was Buddy you know. And you too. Buddy was like that.
But, but Louie never gives Buddy credit.
